notes.title: Update 2707946
notes.content:
In this update, I updated the textures a bit and corrected some bugs, but I'm not here for that.

[h1]Important!!![/h1]
Playing in Quanect, you noticed the crashes from the game after the death of the character or when moving to another level. Since I develop the game alone, I fulfill all duties. That is, I am a developer and a tester. And during the game test on my computer everything was fine. I learned about the error from you!
I'm trying very hard to fix this bug. I promise that the update will be released soon.

tags.bug: I'm trying very hard to fix this bug.
